sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 31 points from 15 games, travel to Telford Town on Saturday 7 November for a 15:00 kick-off. Telford are bottom of the division with just 7 points and have lost their last three league matches, making this a fixture where Sandbach will be heavy favorites. Despite recent losses to their name, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be looking to bounce back immediately.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth host Stafford Town in a meeting of second and third in the table, with Bridgnorth's excellent recent form (one loss in their last six) pitting them against the consistent Stafford side who have picked up steady results. Eccleshall, also near the top, face New Mills away on Saturday, with Eccleshall's three consecutive league wins putting them in strong form. Wolverhampton Casuals are in impressive form with five wins from their last six league games and host Foley Meir on both Saturday and Wednesday (the Wednesday fixture at 20:00). Bilston Town, in sixth place and unbeaten in their last five league matches, welcome Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday before traveling to face Alsager Town on Wednesday evening—Alsager have won just once in 13 games and are among the division's poorest performers. Barnton face Market Drayton Town, with Barnton's strong recent run (four consecutive wins) contrasting sharply with Drayton's struggles. Brereton Social host Shawbury United in a clash of lower-table sides, while Allscott Heath welcome Wednesfield Community—both teams are mid-table or lower. Crewe travel to face Dawley Town on Saturday afternoon. Widnes Town, second-bottom with 6 points and recent losses, travel to AFC Bridgnorth on Tuesday evening in a rearranged fixture.
